parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols mpls label-protocol ldp.explanation: 配置MPLS的标签分发协议为LDP。

parameters.name: label-protocol
parameters.explanation: 指定MPLS使用的标签分发协议。

set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/0.0.template: set protocols isis interface [parameter1] family inet address [parameter2]/[parameter3]
set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/0.0.command: set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/0.0 family inet address 10.1.2.1/24
set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/0.0.explanation: 在ISIS协议中配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

set protocols isis interface lo0.0 famil.template: set protocols isis interface [parameter1] family inet address [parameter2]/[parameter3]
set protocols isis interface lo0.0 famil.command: set protocols isis interface lo0.0 family inet address 1.1.1.1/32
set protocols isis interface lo0.0 famil.explanation: 在ISIS协议中配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: net
parameters.explanation: ISIS的网络实体标题，用于标识ISIS域中的路由器。

set protocols isis mpls traffic-eng leve.command: set protocols isis mpls traffic-eng level-2
set protocols isis mpls traffic-eng leve.explanation: 在ISIS中启用MPLS流量工程，并指定层级为Level-2。

set protocols isis metric-style wide lev.command: set protocols isis metric-style wide level-2
set protocols isis metric-style wide lev.explanation: 配置ISIS的度量风格为wide，并指定层级为Level-2。

parameters.name: level
parameters.explanation: 指定应用度量风格的层级。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng logging.explanation: 启用MPLS流量工程的日志记录功能。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng auto-bw.explanation: 启用MPLS流量工程的自动带宽调整功能。

parameters.name: area
parameters.explanation: 指定MPLS流量工程的区域号。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng affinity-.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程的亲和性映射。

set protocols pce client segment-routing.explanation: 启用PCE客户端的段路由功能。

set protocols pce client segment-routing.command: set protocols pce client segment-routing sr-mpls
set protocols pce client segment-routing.explanation: 配置PCE客户端的段路由类型为SR-MPLS。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.2.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 1.1.1.1/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces gr-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]
set interfaces gr-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces gr-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address unnumbered
set interfaces gr-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址为未编号。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

parameters.name: address
parameters.explanation: 接口的IPv4地址配置，此处为未编号。

set interfaces gr-0/0/0 tunnel mode mpls.command: set interfaces gr-0/0/0 tunnel mode mpls traffic-eng
set interfaces gr-0/0/0 tunnel mode mpls.explanation: 配置接口的隧道模式为MPLS流量工程。

set interfaces gr-0/0/0 tunnel mpls traf.template: set interfaces [parameter1] tunnel mpls traffic-eng autoroute announce
set interfaces gr-0/0/0 tunnel mpls traf.command: set interfaces gr-0/0/0 tunnel mpls traffic-eng autoroute announce
set interfaces gr-0/0/0 tunnel mpls traf.explanation: 启用MPLS流量工程隧道的自动路由通告功能。

set interfaces gr-0/0/0 tunnel mpls traf.template: set interfaces [parameter1] tunnel mpls traffic-eng path-option [parameter2] explicit name [parameter3]
set interfaces gr-0/0/0 tunnel mpls traf.command: set interfaces gr-0/0/0 tunnel mpls traffic-eng path-option 1 explicit name PCE-DELEGATE
set interfaces gr-0/0/0 tunnel mpls traf.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程隧道的路径选项。

set interfaces gr-0/0/0 tunnel mpls traf.template: set interfaces [parameter1] tunnel mpls traffic-eng segment-routing
set interfaces gr-0/0/0 tunnel mpls traf.command: set interfaces gr-0/0/0 tunnel mpls traffic-eng segment-routing
set interfaces gr-0/0/0 tunnel mpls traf.explanation: 启用MPLS流量工程隧道的段路由功能。

commit.explanation: 提交配置更改，使其生效。
